title: Protocol for analyzing the biosynthesis and degradation of N-glycan precursors in mammalian cells
protocol: Aspirate culture medium from a ϕ100 mm culture dish.
Wash the cells once with 5 mL of D-PBS (-).
Add 1 mL of 0.05% (w/v) trypsin-0.53 mM EDTA to dish.
Incubate cells for 1–2 min at 37°C in a CO2 incubator.
Tap the lateral side of the dish to detach cells.
Add 9 mL of the complete medium.
Pipette up and down to dissociate cells.
Transfer the cell suspension to a fresh 15-mL centrifuge tube.
Mix 10 μL of the cell suspension and 10 μL of 0.4% (w/v) trypan blue dye in a 1.5-mL centrifuge tube.
Count the live and dead cells using a hemocytometer.
Aspirate the culture medium from a ϕ100 mm culture dish.
Wash the cells two times with 5 mL each of 1× PBS warmed up at 25°C.
Aspirate the residual PBS completely.
Place the dish on ice.
Add 2 mL of cell lysis solution (70% v/v ethanol) to the dish.
Scrape cells with a scraper on ice and transfer the homogenate into a fresh 15-mL centrifuge tube by pipetting.
Vortex the homogenate (∼4 ml) for 10 s.
Incubate the homogenate for 15 min at 0°C.
Centrifuge the homogenate at 10,000 × g for 10 min at 4°C.
Transfer the supernatant (∼4 mL) to a fresh 15-mL centrifuge tube by pipetting.
Add 2 mL of methanol to the cell pellets that were prepared previously.
Vortex vigorously until the cell pellets become uniformly dispersed in methanol.
Centrifuge at 1,800 × g for 5 min at 25°C.
Discard the supernatant by decantation.
Repeat steps a–d one more time.
Add 2 mL of chloroform/methanol (2:1, v/v) to the pellets.
Vortex vigorously until the cell pellets become uniformly dispersed.
Centrifuge at 1,800 × g for 5 min at 25°C.
Discard the supernatant by decantation.
Repeat steps f–i one more time.
Dry the pellets under a nitrogen stream.
Add 2 mL of 4 mM MgCl2 in methanol/water (1:1, v/v) to the pellet.
Vortex vigorously until the cell pellet becomes uniformly dispersed.
Centrifuge at 1,800 × g for 5 min at 25°C.
Discard the supernatant completely by decantation.
Add 2 mL of chloroform/methanol/water (10:10:3, v/v/v) to the pellet.
Vortex vigorously until the cell pellets become uniformly dispersed.
Close the cap of tubes and incubate them for 10 min at 37°C.
Centrifuge at 1,800 × g for 5 min at 25°C.
Transfer the supernatant to a fresh 9-mL glass test tube with a screw cap using a glass Pasteur pipette with a nipple.
Repeat steps q–t for the remaining pellets one more time.
Transfer the second supernatant to the glass tube that contains the first supernatant.
Store the combined supernatant at −20°C for at least 1 week.
Evaporate the combined supernatant to dryness using a Speed-Vac or under a nitrogen stream.
Set the temperature of the centrifugal part of the Speed-Vac to “Ambient.”
Store the dried DLO pellets at −20°C for at least 1 week.
Add 1 mL of 20 mM HCl in 50% (v/v) 2-propanol to the dried DLO pellets.
Close the cap, briefly vortex, and allow the tubes to stand on a metal rack.
Heat the tubes for 30 min at 100°C in an oven or use a heat block.
Chill the tubes in a rack by immersing them into ice-water bath for 3 min.
Evaporate the hydrolysates to dryness using a Speed-Vac or under a nitrogen stream.
Set the temperature of the centrifugal part of the Speed-Vac to “Ambient.”
Wash the Speed-Vac by evaporating 100 mL of water after evaporating HCl.
Add 1 mL of Milli-Q water to the dried pellets.
Resuspend the released oligosaccharides by vigorous vortexing for 10 seconds.
Centrifuge the tubes at 1,800 × g for 5 minutes at 25°C.
Transfer the supernatant to a fresh 15-mL centrifuge tube.
Repeat steps f–h one more time.
Transfer the second supernatant to the tube that contains the first supernatant.
Place an InertSep GC column in each 15-mL centrifuge tube.
Add 2.5 mL of 100% acetonitrile to the top of the column.
Let the solution pass through the column and discard the eluate.
Add 2.5 mL of Milli-Q water to the top of the column.
Let the solution pass through the column and discard the eluate.
Repeat steps e and f one more time.
Add the combined supernatant (approximately 2 mL) obtained in step 24k to the top of the activated InertSep GC column.
Let the sample completely enter the column and discard the eluate.
Add 2.5 mL of Milli-Q water to the top of the column.
Let water pass through the column and discard the eluate.
Repeat steps j and k one more time.
Wipe the outside of the InertSep GC columns with clean KimWipes.
Place the columns in fresh 15-mL centrifuge tubes.
Add 2.5 mL of 25% (v/v) acetonitrile to the top of the column.
Collect the eluate (2.5 mL).
Concentrate the eluate obtained to ∼0.5 mL using a Speed-Vac or under nitrogen stream.
If the eluate is completely dried, add 500 μL of water.
Vortex for 10 s and spin down.
Transfer the solution to a fresh 1.5-mL centrifuge tube.
Dry the solution completely using a Speed-Vac or under a nitrogen stream.
Equilibrate size-exclusion columns (SEC, 1 column for each sample).
Open the top lid of the PD MidiTrap G-25 column.
Discard the storage buffer from the column.
Remove the bottom cap of the column.
Stand the columns on the attached rack.
Place a waste container below the columns.
Fill the top space of the column with Milli-Q water.
Let the water pass through the column.
Repeat steps c and d two more times.
Cap the bottom end of the column.
Close the top lid until use.
Equilibrate Sep-Pak Accell Plus QMA cartridge (1 cartridge for each sample).
Remove the piston from a 5-mL syringe.
Connect the outlet of the syringe to the inlet of a QMA cartridge.
Add 5 mL of 10 mM Tris-HCl (pH 7.4) to the syringe.
Place a piston and push it to elute buffer at a rate of approximately 2 drops/s.
Dry the cartridge by blowing out air from a syringe.
Disconnect the syringe and remove the piston.
Connect the syringe outlet to the cartridge.
Store the cartridge at room temperature until use.
Add 1.0 mL of Milli-Q water to the dried cell extract obtained in step 22.
Vortex vigorously until the pellet is completely dispersed.
Transfer the suspension to a fresh 1.5-mL centrifugation tube.
Centrifuge at 15,000 × g for 3 min at 25°C.
Add exactly 1 mL of supernatant to PD MidiTrap G-25 columns that have been equilibrated with water.
Ensure water is completely removed from the top space of the column before adding the sample.
Let the sample enter into the column and discard the initial eluate.
Place a 2.0-mL centrifuge tube just beneath the column outlet.
Add 1.5 mL of water to the top of the column.
Collect the eluate (1.5 mL).
Add 15 μL of 1 M Tris-HCl (pH 7.4) to the eluate and mix thoroughly.
Add the eluate (1.5 mL) to the syringe connected to Sep-Pak Accell Plus QMA cartridge.
Place a piston on the syringe and push at a rate of approximately 2 drops/s.
Discard the flow-through.
Dry the cartridge by blowing out air from a syringe.
Disconnect the syringe from QMA cartridge.
Remove the piston.
Connect the same syringe to the QMA cartridge.
Add 5 mL of 10 mM Tris-HCl (pH 7.4) to the syringe.
Place a piston and push at a rate of approximately 2 drops/s.
Discard the flow-through.
Dry the cartridge by blowing out air from a syringe.
Repeat steps from g to k one more time.
Connect a fresh 5-mL syringe without a piston to the QMA cartridge.
Add 5 mL of 10 mM Tris-HCl (pH 7.4) containing 70 mM NaCl to the syringe.
Place a piston and push at a rate of approximately 2 drops/s.
Collect the eluate in a 15-mL centrifuge tube.
Mix the eluate by vortexing.
Spin down the eluate.
Divide the eluate (5 mL) obtained in step equally to two portions (2.5 mL each).
Add 5 μL of rAPid alkaline phosphatase to one half and mix thoroughly.
The other half is left untreated with phosphatase.
Incubate the samples with or without phosphatase for 16 h at 37°C.
Place an InertSep GC column in a 15-mL centrifuge tube.
Add 2.5 mL of 100% acetonitrile to the top space of the column.
Discard the eluate passing through the column.
Add 2.5 mL of Milli-Q water to the top space of the column.
Discard the eluate passing through the column.
Repeat steps adding 2.5 mL of 100% acetonitrile and discarding the eluate.
Repeat steps adding 2.5 mL of Milli-Q water and discarding the eluate.
Add 2.5 mL of reaction mixtures to the activated InertSep GC column.
Discard the eluate passing through the column.
Add 2.5 mL of Milli-Q water to the top space of the column.
Discard the eluate passing through the column.
Repeat steps adding 2.5 mL of Milli-Q water and discarding the eluate.
Wipe the outside of InertSep GC columns with clean KimWipes.
Place the columns into fresh 15-mL centrifuge tubes.
Add 2.5 mL of 25% (v/v) acetonitrile to the top space of the column.
Collect the eluate passing through the column.
Concentrate the eluate to approximately 0.5 mL using a Speed-Vac or under a nitrogen stream.
Set the temperature of the centrifugal part of the Speed-Vac to "Ambient."
If the eluate is completely dried, add 500 μL of water and vortex.
Spin down the mixture.
Transfer the solution to a fresh 1.5-mL centrifuge tube.
Dry the solution completely using a Speed-Vac or under a nitrogen stream.
Set the temperature of the centrifugal part of the Speed-Vac to "Ambient."
Vortex the dried sample well and spin it down.
Pause point: Store the dried samples at -20°C for at least one week.
Dissolve PA in the solution by heating at 80°C.
Vortex and spin down the solution.
Pipette out 20 μL of PA solution and add it to dried free glycan preparations.
Vortex for 10 seconds and spin down.
Incubate for 1 hour at 80°C in the dark.
Add 20 μL of dimethylamine-borane complex solution to the reaction mixture.
Mix thoroughly by vortexing and spin down.
Incubate for 1 hour at 80°C in the dark.
Pause point: The reaction mixture can be stored at -20°C for 2-3 days if needed.
Add 960 μL of acetonitrile to the reaction mixture.
Mix thoroughly by vortexing and spin down.
Activate MonoFas spin columns by adding 200 μL of Milli-Q water, then centrifuge at 10,000 × g for 30 seconds and discard eluate.
Add 700 μL of 100% acetonitrile to the spin column, then centrifuge at 10,000 × g for 30 seconds and discard eluate.
Repeat activation steps one more time.
Purify PA-labeled glycans by adding 700 μL of PA labeling reaction mixture to an activated MonoFas spin column, then centrifuge at 10,000 × g for 30 seconds and discard eluate.
Add the remaining PA labeling reaction mixture to the same spin column.
Centrifuge at 10,000 × g for 30 seconds and discard the eluate.
Add 700 μL of 95% (v/v) acetonitrile to the spin column.
Centrifuge at 10,000 × g for 30 seconds and discard the eluate.
Repeat steps centrifuging with 95% acetonitrile one more time.
Centrifuge at 10,000 × g for 30 seconds to remove remaining acetonitrile solution.
Remove the spin column from tube and place onto a fresh 1.5-mL centrifuge tube.
Add 100 μL of Milli-Q water to the spin column.
Centrifuge at 10,000 × g for 30 seconds.
Repeat steps adding Milli-Q water and centrifuging one more time in the same tube.
Start the HPLC system and connect Shodex NH2P-50 4E column.
Set the gradient program as specified in the materials and equipment section.
Equilibrate the column for 20 minutes by running a mixed eluent (97% HPLC eluent A and 3% HPLC eluent B).
Add 10 μL of samples to the bottom of snap vials.
Take great care not to leave any air between sample solution and the bottom of vials during preparation.
Seal the vial with a snap cap after filling.
Set the sealed vial to the auto-sampler for analysis.
Analyze samples starting with Milli-Q water (10 μL).
Follow with standard PA-labeled glycans (2 pmol as PA-labeled glucose hexamer).
Finally, analyze your PA-labeled glycan samples.
Replace HPLC lines with 20% (v/v) acetonitrile to shut down the system.
Wash the HPLC column with storage solvent at a flow rate of 0.8 mL/min for 20 minutes.
Disconnect and cap both ends of the HPLC column before storing at room temperature.
Connect the outlet of the injector and the inlet of the detector with a plug to prevent drying out of HPLC lines.
Culture cells in ϕ100 mm dishes.
Wash the cells once with 5 mL of ice-cold PBS.
Aspirate residual PBS completely.
Add 500 μL of ice-cold 70% (v/v) ethanol to the dish.
Scrape the cells and pipette in and out three times to disperse cell aggregates.
Transfer the cell suspension (∼500 μL) into a fresh 1.5-mL centrifuge tube.
Homogenize the cell suspension using a Bioruptor for 5 min at 0°C.
Add 5 μL of unnatural 0.5 mM GDP-Glc (2.5 nmol) to the cell suspension as an internal standard.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 16,000 × g for 15 min at 4°C.
Transfer the supernatant to a 1.5-mL centrifuge tube.
Freeze the supernatant at −20°C.
Evaporate using a Speed-Vac concentrator with the temperature set to “Ambient.”
Activate ENVI-Carb columns by adding 2 mL of 80% (v/v) acetonitrile in 0.1% (v/v) TFA.
Wash the column with 1 mL of distilled water.
Dissolve freeze-dried samples in 1 mL of 10 mM NH4HCO3.
Apply the sample to the activated ENVI-Carb column.
Sequentially wash the column once with 1 mL of water, then 1 mL of 25% (v/v) acetonitrile, followed by 200 μL of water.
Wash again with 1 mL of 50 mM triethylamine acetate buffer (pH 7.0).
Elute nucleotide sugars from the column using 1 mL of 25% (v/v) acetonitrile in 50 mM triethylamine acetate buffer (pH 7.0).
Evaporate eluates to dryness using a Speed-Vac concentrator.
Set the MS conditions for nucleotide sugar analysis.
Program the m/z values for precursor ions and product ions.
Run authentic standard mixtures containing 10 pmol each.
Confirm robust peak production on the LC-MS system.
Prepare a calibration curve using diluted authentic standards at specified concentrations.
Dissolve extracted nucleotide sugars in distilled water (50 μL).
Apply aliquots (10 μL) for LC-MS analysis.
Extract the peak areas of nucleotide sugars in extraction ion chromatograms.
